title: acrostichum glabellum
intro: Acrostichum glabellum, commonly known as the mangrove fern, is a species of fern native to tropical and subtropical regions, particularly in mangrove swamps. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acrostichum glabellum include antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with infections and inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in the development of new treatments for various health conditions.
